title: Size Exchange and Instant Exchange Terms
content:
These are the Returns & Exchanges terms for exchanges: what may be exchanged, when the replacement ships, and how the card hold behind an Instant Exchange is placed, released and charged.

## What an exchange is

1. An exchange replaces returned units with the same style at the same price in another size or colour. A different style, or a price difference, is a return plus a new order.
2. The replacement ships free, as a no-charge order (no shipping fee for the replacement).

## Size Exchange

3. A Size Exchange ships the replacement at settlement. When the replacement is out of stock by then, the return is settled as a refund to the original tenders.

## Instant Exchange

4. An Instant Exchange ships the replacement at authorization and is offered only when the original order was paid at least partly by card or wallet and the replacement's retail value does not exceed 400.00 USD.
5. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause providing that an Instant Exchange hold is placed only with the customer's own consent to a card hold of the replacement price plus tax has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
6. The hold is released when the returns centre receives the parcel, and charged when the return expires, is cancelled, or every original unit is rejected or missing at inspection. For a partial rejection the hold is charged in full and the accepted units are refunded to the original tenders at settlement.
7. A hold is released only while the return is in status received, inspected or settled. A hold is charged only while the return is in status expired, cancelled or inspected.

## Hold outcomes

| What happens to the return | Hold | Permitted return statuses for that action |
|---|---|---|
| Parcel received at the returns centre | Released | Received, inspected or settled |
| Return expires (no scan by the return-by date) | Charged | Expired |
| Return cancelled | Charged | Cancelled |
| Every original unit rejected or missing at inspection | Charged | Inspected |
| Some units rejected at inspection | Charged in full; accepted units refunded to the original tenders at settlement | Inspected |

## Points of judgement

- A customer wanting a different colour of the same style at the same price: an exchange. A customer wanting a different style: a return plus a new order.
- Example (hypothetical): an order paid entirely with a gift card does not qualify for an Instant Exchange; an order paid partly by card and partly by gift card does, provided the replacement is valued at 400.00 USD or less.

superseded_clauses: An Instant Exchange hold is placed only with the customer's own consent to a card hold of the replacement price plus tax (`hold_amount_basis`).
